question:
What is the value of

(7)/(9) - frac{{11}}{{12}} + frac{{13}}{{16}} - (1)/(8)?
solution:
**Given:**

(7)/(9) - frac{{11}}{{12}} + frac{{13}}{{16}} - (1)/(8)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Taking the LCM of denominators 9, 12, 16 and 8,

⇒ LCM of 9, 12, 16, and 8 = 144

⇒ (7)/(9) - frac{{11}}{{12}} + frac{{13}}{{16}} - (1)/(8) = (7times 16-11times 12+13times 9-18)/(144)

⇒ (112-132+117-18)/(144)=(79)/(144)

**Therefore, the required value of the given expression is (79)/(144)**.
